name: exodiumweb-server
description: Serves Exodium's UI over HTTP and boots eXo games in the browser with js-dos

scripts.fetch-jsdos: mkdir -p vendor && cd vendor && npm pack js-dos@8.4.1 && mkdir -p js-dos && tar -xzf js-dos-8.4.1.tgz -C js-dos --strip-components=1 && rm js-dos-8.4.1.tgz && npm pack js-dos@8.5.3 && mkdir -p js-dos-3dfx && tar -xzf js-dos-8.5.3.tgz -C js-dos-3dfx --strip-components=1 && rm js-dos-8.5.3.tgz
